flows.name: Grant active Project Manager role members Commitments access
steps: Resolve the exact normalized Project Manager role on the requested project
Grant Commitments read and write through the shared module-permission helper
flows.expectedOutcome: The role member can see non-private commitments and create a new commitment

flows.name: Preserve least privilege and explicit overrides
steps: Evaluate explicit module overrides before role-derived access
Limit the role grant to Commitments read and write
Deny other modules, other projects, private visibility, and inactive principals
flows.expectedOutcome: The role grant cannot broaden into admin, private records, or unrelated modules

flows.name: Verify the affected production principal
steps: Authenticate a temporary Andrew Cannon verification session
Locally revoke the temporary verification session
flows.expectedOutcome: Andrew has read and write, lacks admin, and can see SC-001

claims.description: An active Project Manager role member receives project-scoped Commitments read and write
Explicit overrides retain precedence and the role does not grant admin, private visibility, other projects, or other modules
